name: KinetRig (AI Remotion Video Production Engine)
description: AI-powered motion graphics and cinematic video production engine using Remotion (React). Converts prompts into Remotion compositions, and automatically launches the interactive Remotion Studio in the browser for visual editing and custom rendering.
ai_instructions:
Follow the official KinetRig Remotion workflow (https://github.com/Reff33/KinetRig):

1. CREATIVE DIRECTOR RECOMMENDATION & AUTO-LAUNCH:
   • When the user asks for a video, act as a Creative Director:
     1. Recommend the best template:
        - `CinematicTitle`: Opener & Brand Teasers
        - `GlitchTerminal`: Cybersecurity, Hacker, Code, Decrypt
        - `SaasMacro`: SaaS UI, Analytics, Business Dashboards
        - `BentoGrid`: Modular Features, Architecture, Capabilities
        - `ChatDialogue`: Conversational UI, AI Chatbots, Messaging
        - `DataMetrics`: Financial KPIs, Counters, Dynamic Bar Charts
        - `ReelHook`: Viral Short-Form, High-Retention Hooks (Shorts/TikTok)
        - `ProductShowcase`: E-Commerce, Hardware, 3D Product Demos
        - `ActionFlow`: Continuous Vector Movement, Traversing World
        - `EditorialDossier`: Forensic Investigative Journalism, Redaction
     2. Update `Root.tsx` with the recommended concept & palette.
     3. Execute `node scripts/preview-remotion.mjs` immediately to launch Remotion Studio in the browser.
     4. Explain the choice briefly and invite the user to customize or switch templates in the open Studio.

2. CORE MOTION LAWS:
   • Deterministic Timeline: Timing driven by useCurrentFrame() and interpolate(). Never use Math.random() or Date.now().
   • Zero OS Emojis: Strictly inline SVG vectors or high-fidelity typography. Never use emojis.
   • Anti-PowerPoint: Continuous camera moves (push-in, whip-pan, dolly-zoom). Never static fades.
   • 1 Statement Per Shot: Text under 5 words per beat. Max 2 text levels per scene.

3. AUTONOMOUS STEPS:
   • Step 1: Analyze brief and choose recommended template.
   • Step 2: Update composition defaultProps in `remotion/Root.tsx` (or `rigtools/kinet_rig/remotion/Root.tsx`).
   • Step 3: Run `node scripts/preview-remotion.mjs` to launch Remotion Studio in the browser.

claude_command.name: kinet-rig
claude_command.content:
# /kinet-rig <brief> [aspect_ratio] [concept/style]

Create a video, recommend templates, and launch Remotion Studio:

1. **Recommend Template:** Pick best fit (`CinematicTitle`, `GlitchTerminal`, `SaasMacro`, `BentoGrid`, `ChatDialogue`, `DataMetrics`, `ReelHook`, `ProductShowcase`, `ActionFlow`, or `EditorialDossier`).
2. **Update Props:** Set `defaultProps` in `remotion/Root.tsx`.
3. **Launch Studio:** Execute immediately:
   `node scripts/preview-remotion.mjs`
   This opens Remotion Studio in the browser so the user can preview the recommendation and customize live.
